title: Instruction-Aware Cooperative TLB and Cache Replacement Policies
problem: Modern server and data center applications have large instruction footprints that cause frequent instruction-side TLB and cache misses, with instruction TLB (iTLB) misses being particularly harmful because they cause pipeline stalls that block forward progress. Existing TLB and cache replacement policies treat instruction and data streams equivalently and do not account for the criticality of instruction accesses.
motivation: As server applications grow in code size (microservices, JIT-compiled runtimes, large binaries), instruction working sets no longer fit in iTLBs and instruction caches, making instruction-side misses a dominant performance bottleneck in production workloads.
method: The paper proposes instruction-aware cooperative replacement policies that distinguish instruction accesses from data accesses in both the TLB and cache. The cooperative approach coordinates eviction decisions between the iTLB and the instruction cache (iCache), so that evicting a page from the iTLB also triggers or informs iCache eviction decisions and vice versa, reducing redundant refills. Replacement decisions are guided by instruction-access frequency and recency, with policy cooperation preventing the two structures from working at cross-purposes during instruction working set thrashing.
key_novelty: Cooperative replacement policies that jointly manage iTLB and iCache evictions using instruction-access awareness, preventing the two structures from independently evicting and refilling the same instruction working set.
contributions: Analysis quantifying instruction TLB and cache miss rates as a dominant bottleneck in server/data center workloads
Instruction-aware replacement policy distinguishing instruction vs. data access patterns in TLB and cache
Cooperative iTLB-iCache replacement framework that coordinates eviction decisions across both structures
Performance evaluation on server workloads demonstrating reduced instruction miss rates and improved throughput

metrics.other: reduced instruction TLB and cache miss rates in server workloads; specific numbers not in abstract

baselines: standard LRU/RRIP replacement policies for TLB and cache
limitations: Specific quantitative improvements in throughput or miss rate reduction are not provided in the abstract.
primary_theme: cooperative instruction-aware TLB and cache replacement for server workloads
